Name: JojaMart Freight Truck
Author: Sable17
Description:
[quote][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]JojaMart [/size][/color][size=4]will never claim that beautiful Parsnip you sold was grown by them![/size] [size=1][i]Cough... Pierre...[/i][/size][/quote]
After purchasing a [b][color=#6d9eeb]Joja Membership[/color][/b], a JojaMart Freight Truck makes stops in town! 

Plus they erect a nice billboard for everyone to see!

[b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart Freight Truck[/color][/b]
• The truck stops outside of the tunnel on [b]Monday[/b], [b]Wednesday[/b], and [b]Friday[/b], [b]between 800-2200[/b].
• [b]Closed [/b]on [b]Festival [/b]days! So the truck wont be there.
• [b]Will buy most items you want to sell[/b], just like Pierre and without the icky Pierre interactions!
• Also sells damaged crates and discount Joja Cola! 

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBiteTVDinners [/url]installed, Dented Cans and TV Dinner crates will be sold here too!
Neither mod is a requirement though.

[color=#6d9eeb][b]Damaged[/b][/color][b][color=#6d9eeb] Freight Crates[/color]
[/b][color=#ffffff]• Each crate contains varying amounts of [b]discounted [/b]goods. [/color]
• Right click with the crate in your hands to pry it open.

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• SpaceCore - For opening crates with a right click.
• BETAS - For clearing bushes.

[b]Incompatible with:[/b]
Other mods that occupy the same space. There will be clipping/overwriting. Binning Skill for sure.
